nodes.label: Free Fire Storm Arena Live Leaderboard UI Screenshot
nodes.description: Mobile battle royale pre-match lobby UI screenshot (Free Fire Storm Arena) combining a central 3D arena viewport, a persistent top-left 4-player squad HUD, and a right-docked live multi-squad leaderboard overlay drawer.

nodes.label: Right-Side Live Leaderboard Drawer
nodes.description: Right-docked scrollable scoreboard overlay showing ALL/NEARBY tabs, squad-grouped player rows (Squads 4 through 7 visible), kill-count column, and vertical scrollbar.

nodes.label: ALL / NEARBY Tabbed Leaderboard Filter
nodes.rationale: Separates global match standings (ALL, active tab) from spatial proximity filtering (NEARBY) in a compact dual-tab drawer header so players can inspect full-lobby or local rankings without leaving the viewport.

nodes.label: Squad-Grouped Color-Coded Leaderboard Rows
nodes.rationale: Groups up to four player slots (1-4) under a shared left-hand squad number column (4, 5, 6, 7) with distinct slot color badges to preserve team hierarchy inside a flat scrollable scoreboard.

nodes.label: Active Player Gold Highlight and Distant Squad Dimming
nodes.rationale: Highlights the local player's row (Squad 5 Slot 1: VIVEK_4X_57) with a gold border and eye icon while dimming distant or unstreamed squads (Squads 6 and 7) so the user can immediately locate themselves and active squadmates.

nodes.label: Diamond Skull Kill Score Metric Column
nodes.description: Right-aligned metric column on each leaderboard row displaying a diamond-framed skull icon and numeric kill count (0 across all entries in pre-match state).

nodes.label: Top-Left Persistent Squad Status HUD
nodes.description: Persistent top-left HUD displaying match telemetry (23 players alive, 0 kills, 61 ms ping) and Squad 5 roster (1 vivek_4x_57, 2 KevalKing777, 3 M4rCo✿✿2.o, 4 ¨¨AmitBoos) with health bars and map-pin or leader-flag icons.

nodes.label: Storm Arena 3D Lobby Viewport
nodes.description: Central 3D pre-match sci-fi corridor labeled STORM ARENA showing third-person avatars, floating squad nametags with distance markers (19 m, 4 m), and equipped weapon tag (AWM).
